title: subscriptions/user_flags user_id retention undocumented
description:
Migrations 0011/0012 dropped user_id from mailbox_messages and user_mailboxes, but subscriptions and user_flags tables retain user_id columns. This is intentional design for single-operator per-user state (subscriptions and flags are per-user even though mailbox content is shared), but there is NO comment in the code explaining this.

Future maintainer reading the 'simplify to single-user' epic will see user_id in these tables and think they're stale, risking accidental removal and data corruption.

Required fix: Add a doc comment to subscriptions.rs and flags.rs explaining that user_id is retained because subscriptions and keyword flags are per-user state, even in single-operator mode. Example: '/// Manages per-user newsgroup subscriptions.\n/// Note: user_id is retained even in single-operator mode because each authenticated\n/// session maintains its own subscription list (equivalent to a newsreader profile).'
